entities.label: California Real Estate Political Action Committee (CREPAC)
entities.description: C.A.R.'s state-level PAC for direct contributions to CA STATE candidates (per C.A.R.'s own materials: 'CREPAC funds are used to support campaigns for candidates running for state-level elected offices'). This is a CA FPPC matter, NOT an FEC matter -- CREPAC-State would not be the vehicle for any contribution to Rep. Simon's federal committee (C00834291). If a CREPAC entity contributes to federal candidates, it would need to be a legally distinct 'CREPAC-Federal' or similar FEC-registered committee, not yet identified separately.
entities.source: General web search corroboration of C.A.R.'s own published PAC/dues materials, accessed 2026-10-03.
entities.jurisdiction_note: CA state (FPPC), not federal (FEC) -- per C.A.R.'s own description. A separate federal-level REALTOR PAC vehicle, if contributions to Rep. Simon are to be tested, would need to be identified and confirmed as a distinct FEC-registered committee, not assumed to be this same CREPAC entity.
